title: Reverse the list into descending order
description:
Reverse the list in descending order using reverse() method.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as sort_companies_descending(companies), returning a new list with the companies sorted in descending (reverse alphabetical) order.
hints: First get the list into ascending order, the same way as the sort exercise.
Lists have a reverse() method that flips the current order of the list in place.
updated.sort() then updated.reverse(), and return updated.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list containing the companies sorted alphabetically descending.
solution:
def sort_companies_descending(companies):
    updated = companies.copy()
    updated.sort()
    updated.reverse()
    return updated
explanation: Sorting ascending and then reversing produces descending order; list.reverse() flips the current element order in place.
